verdict.rationale: Feitian documents the BioPass key's on-device fingerprint matching: biometric data never leaves the key, and it prevents misuse by anyone other than the enrolled user, so a lost key poses no risk. FIDO PIN management is also documented through iePassManager, covering the PIN path for user verification. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor-claimed), detailed FIDO2 PIN documentation (e.g. retry limits/lockout, enforcement on non-biometric models).
